snippet.title: MHO Original Elder Dragon "Ruger Aidal" Revealed! | Pre-Registration Now Open
snippet.description:
A colossal monster emerged from the sea of clouds, its radiance descending like judgment.
The moment it arrived, the world witnessed a second sun.

Its name... Ruger Aidal.

MHO is coming in 2026 — stay tuned!  
Pre-registration is now open. Click the link below or search Monster Hunter Outlanders to pre-register!

https://mhopreregister.onelink.me/4OcS/cqsi981o

Subscribe for the latest updates and follow us on:
X: https://x.com/MHO_English
Facebook: https://www.facebook.com/MHO.English
Instagram: https://www.instagram.com/mho_english/
Discord:  https://discord.com/invite/mho
